blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte has shared that she has not yet discussed with her defense team if she can testify as a witness in her own impeachment trial as the proceedings resume next week. During a press conference on Friday, Duterte was asked if she had already thought of standing as a witness in her own trial. Her defense team began presenting witnesses and evidence last November 9. “Attending as witness, that is something that I need to discuss with the defense team for the impeachment trial and we are not there yet,” Duterte answered. “Ang sabi kasi […]...
